dct_description_sm:
This dataset includes all of the voting places available to voters for the 2026 general election. The City of Vancouver uses a Vote-Anywhere model. Since 2014, Vancouver voters can vote at any voting place within the City.

The City operates an at-large voting system.

Advance voting days: October 3, 7, 10 and 13, 2026

Election day: October 17, 2026

Voting hours for all locations are 8am to 8pm.

Note

UBC and UEL voters are only eligible to vote for School Trustees. They can vote at the 59 advance voting places on October 3, 7, 10 and 13. On October 7 and 13, they can also vote at the UBC AMS Student Nest. On election day, October 17, they can vote at either the UBC AMS Student Nest or University Hill Secondary School.

Data currency

These are the voting places used for the City's 2026 local election during advance voting and on general voting day.
